text:
Anika: quick thread 1h after release: Support flagged a customer-reported regression in embeddings: downstream batching spikes CPU and causes throttles. Sales wants quick reassurance; product also has three small follow-ons requested by early adopters. do we prioritize the backport hotfix or schedule the follow-ons into next minor?

Cole: need impact numbers. if it's customer-facing throttles, hotfix first. how many customers affected?

Anika: two customers saw retry storms on nightly jobs; error spikes correlate with our embeddings v2 rollout. traffic pattern: batch size 128 -> 512, CPU 40% -> 85%, retries x4.

Priya: from product POV, follow-ons are adoption polish (docs, example notebooks, small API ergonomic changes). low-roi if a big regression persists. +1 hotfix.

Tom: ops data: the throttles are hitting quota middleware because workers slow down, causing retries which amplify load. fix could be either batching clamp or optimizing the async path. quick win: clamp client batch size for now (server-side guard) and schedule runtime perf spike for next week. estimate: 1 dev half-day to add clamp + 2h rollout/monitor.

support-bot: @Anika Escalation created: ESC-5521. Notify: #sales, #eng-runtime.

Cole: proposal: run emergency micro-patch to add server-side batch clamp and a 1-line fix in client examples; then do a 1-week focused perf epic next sprint for the runtime path. that way sales can tell customers we've mitigated.

Priya: acceptance criteria for mitigation: no customer should see >3% retry rate within 48h under peak jobs; client examples updated and published; docs note added. follow-ons move to next minor with owner.

Anika: decision: prioritize mitigation now. Cole to own hotfix PR, Tom to coordinate canary + throttles monitoring. Priya to own follow-on backlog and push a clear timeline to sales. freeze: only hotfix+docs merges allowed into main until mitigation verified.

Cole: I'll open PR and label with bug:hotfix. ETA 6h for PR, then canary.

Tom: canary plan:
```
1. enable batch_clamp=true on canary pool
2. route 2% traffic for 1h
3. monitor retries per-customer: ./scripts/monitor_retries --window 60
4. if retries <3% for 1h, increase to 10% for 2h
```

support-bot: Canary created: canary-emb-1798. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

Priya: i'll update the sales playbook: message to affected customers, ETA for rollback/mitigation, and follow-up plan. propose language: "we've identified a batching edge-case after the embeddings rollout and are deploying a targeted mitigation. expected impact minimal; full perf improvements follow in next minor."

Anika: good. also add postmortem trigger: if retries persist >3% after 48h, open a postmortem and pause further embeddings variants.

Cole: PR link to follow here. will ping when canary hits 10%.

Tom: i'll allocate 2h of SRE time during the canary window for escalation.

Priya: moving follow-ons to board column "next-minor backlog" and assigning owners: docs (Priya), examples (Anika), ergonomic API (TBD).

Anika: thanks team. check-in in 3h. :thumbsup:
